readingNotes.early: Coverage is rising and trading volume has not followed yet.
readingNotes.confirmed: Coverage and trading volume are both up. Usually late.
readingNotes.exhausted: The price has moved and coverage is dying down.
readingNotes.quiet: Neither coverage nor volume stands out.
readingNotes.none: No linked instrument has a quote yet.

primaryYes: A filing, release or central bank statement is in the story.
primaryNo: No filing, release or central bank statement yet.
angleBy: Read from headline words, not by a model:
angleNone: No bullish or bearish words in the headlines.
linksNone: Nothing on the watchlist is tied to this story.
pickStory: Pick a story to see what it is made of.
emptyOld: This news service is older than the stories page. Update newsd.
moversNote: Trading far above its usual pace with no story on the board. Someone may know something.
moversNone: Nothing is trading far above its pace without a story.
tradableNote: Only stories tied to an instrument on the watchlist. Turn off to see everything the engine grouped.

map.modeFromNote: Where the outlets covering each story publish from.
map.modeAboutNote: The places named in the headlines.
map.pickPlace: Pick a country on the map or in the list.
map.noStories: No stories here in the last day.
